ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback on the Weber Q1200! We apologize for your frustration, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have. 

Please make sure the grill is preheating until it reaches 500 to 550. Applying oil to the surface of your food will help prevent food from sticking. 

Double-check the correct temperature for the food that's being prepared. If the grill is too high, that will cause the food to stick. 

Here is a link for review: 
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023849911-How-to-keep-food-from-sticking-to-cooking-grates-

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

Results.ReviewText: Everything sticks…I spend more time cleaning then cooking.  Yes, I even bought the Weber grill spray.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: The recipe chart could use a bit of help as streaks only have 3/4” and 1” thickness but nothing larger Also Zucchini missing from vegetables.
Results.Title: Recipe Chart

Results.ReviewText: Well built, gorgeous grill that cooks well. The burner is designed close to the porcelain grates providing even and high temperature (500*F) cooking.
Results.Title: Powerful compact grill

Results.ReviewText: The Weber grill specifically the Q 1200 is extremely portable. It can be taken anywhere whether you have a car truck. I just cooked a whole chicken in a weber Q 1200 and it turned out great. I love the fact that it can be put on a picnic table or you can use the stand which I purchased, and wheel it around.  I make sure I take care of my grill and clean it each and every time after I cook, some people think that’s a little extreme but as a product that I know will last I will help ensure that it’s safe and clean and will last if I follow that process. Also you can purchase an adapter for the weber Q 1200 so you can use a larger tank of gas.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 is a great grill for a small family.

Results.ReviewText: We bought this to complement our Weber Spirit. With just two of us at home now, it seems like overkill to light the Spirit for a few burger patties. The Q1200 is perfect for those smaller grilled meals. It heats up super fast and hot, a quality you often don't see with smaller barbecues. Super glad we bought the Q1200. Coincidentally, we just stayed at a property that has a Q2200, that model is a fair bit bigger than the Q1200, and would have been an overkill purchase for the two of us.
Results.Title: Excellent Little Barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to assemble and use. Replacing a 4-burner standing grill with something more suitable for two adults.

Results.ReviewText:
Easy to transport.
Compact but enough space to cook 6 burgers:)

Grill works extremely well.
The only drawback is the connection of LP tank is at a tricky angle with limited space.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback! We apologize for your frustration, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have.

The steps you have currently taken would be the steps we would do. If the igniter isn't making a clicking noise, we would want to start by double-checking the battery to confirm it's installed correctly. 

Next, we suggest reviewing whether the wires are correctly inserted into terminals on igniter electrode assembly. Check that the wires are connected to terminals on the electronic igniter module.

Our kind Support team would like to follow up with you. Please be on the lookout for an email, thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to assemble especially for a 75yo woman. This is my second one and the first one lasted 12 years. I think this will probably outlast me.

Results.ReviewText:
This unit packs a lot for its size.  It is light, portable, compact and boy does it heat up fast and hold its heat!!!  Once you get this guy up to heat, you can turn it to low and let it keep going.  
I even pulled it out for our latest power outage to cook breakfast, not bad.

Very happy!
Results.Title: Amazing

Results.ReviewText: I bought this 2 weeks ago. haven t had a chance to use it much, but I like the heat this bbq puts out, and the grates a good,  love elec. ignition, cooks food evenly,  also like that it has a thermometer

Results.ReviewText: It’s the Perfect compact grill with side shelves that fold in under the lid when you are done.  The cooking surface has heavy solid grates.  Cleanup is a snap with the aluminum pan underneath.  It’s very easy to transport for tailgating or evening dinners on the beach.   We love it!
Results.Title: The go anywhere grillthe Weber Q 1200 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: The Q1200 is a great little grill. Since I bought it recently I use it all the time. I actually prefer using it to my larger grill as it just my husband and myself.  I have been using the small propane cylinders, on my second one, but bought the adapter to use the 20 lb propane tank and hopefully I will not have any issues doing that. I didn’t realize how popular this grill is and wish I had purchased it sooner.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little gas grill!  Great for camping or tailgating!  Weber makes a great product and they stand behind what they sell.
Results.Title: Awesome little grill

Results.ReviewText: Cooks really really even, only used it twice so far. Only complaint I have is that the plastic on the legs has really sharp edges, cut both my middle on one hand moving the bbq out of my trailer.
Results.Title: Cooks so even

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and does a great job of grilling. Very reliable thermometer. Food is cooked exactly how we like it.
Results.Title: Easy to use and to clean. Easy click starter.

Results.ReviewText: I bought a regular sized grill last year for home and just had to have a travel size for our trailer.  It is as good as the big guy just compact and easy to store.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: Bought this to replace our old Weber and we have not been disappointed with the performance--heats up quickly and grills items to my liking.  Good size to manoeuvre around. Like our grill very much especially the split grill which makes cleaning the inside of the barbecue easier.
Results.Title: Nice size for seniors

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill! I get complemented on how nice it is and it grills everything beautifully. It also gets hot really fast which is a huge plus! Definitely worth the money! Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: After having gone through many different smaller sized BBQs for my balcony, I finally caved and bought a Weber. I now know why everyone speaks so highly of them. Simple design, sturdy build, even heating, ample grill and depth space - all in all, this is the perfect bbq for a balcony.
Results.Title: Perfect for a Balcony

Results.ReviewText: Nice little gas grill. Perfect for hamburgers, hot dogs or steaks. Cleans easily. A little bit difficult screwing the gas cannister into fitting.
Results.Title: Convenient little gas grill

Results.ReviewText:
Great grill! Love the way it cooks so evenly and predictably.
My one nit-pick is that it goes thru significantly more of the small propane tanks than my old two-burner Coleman unit, but that's a minor complaint, given the great compliments I always get from my family!
Results.Title: Nearly Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this q1200 portable grill and I have been using it for camping and on my boat. it works great and cooks my steaks burgers and sausage very nicely
Results.Title: great for camping!

Results.ReviewText: We love this grill! Now that we are empty nesters, we bought one for summer grilling on our back patio. It's easy to assemble, easy to store away for the winter, amazingly easy to clean too! It looks small, but you can fit more on it than you think. It's a quality product!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText:
The 1200 BBQ is an easy set up and works wonderfully. It is so quiet, grills evenly, and is easy to clean. So far I have made portobellos, steak, chicken and deer sausages all grilled to perfection - friends have been delighted! It is my go to appliance these days! 

I also got the weber stand and cover which is the perfect setup and keeps everything tidy. I am looking forward to summer bbq's by the river!
Results.Title: Perfect portable grill

Results.ReviewText: Received this as a gift and, after the first use, we're very happy with it. Paired it with the portable stand and hose attachment and found it all very convenient to clean and store after use.

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Perfect grill for my small deck and such a fun color. I ordered the tabletop grill, grill cover, and grill stand. The grill is so easy to use and clean up has been easy, too. So happy with this purchase!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this a few weeks ago. My second Weber Grill. We downsized, and I had to get rid of the full-sized Weber grill I had for 11 years.  But honestly, even though the 1200 is smaller, I like it more! Awesome job, Weber friends!

Results.ReviewText: Purchased Q to down size for space reasons. The Q is much smaller, but not noticeable when it comes to cooking. Steaks come out perfectly, as do chicken. Burgers and dogs.
